## Opening

Als-Rhyn starts in the eastern desert with three near-identical conduit towns. The opening consolidates them before turn ten.

## Early → Mid

::claim confirmed src=vco-guide,ca
The conduit network is the strongest early economy lever the faction has.
::

Mid game banks the Book of the Dead chain while fortifying the river line.

## Mid → Late

The books surplus turns into a second casket battery on every front.

## Victory push

The victory push rides the casket battery wave straight up the middle against the weakest remaining faction.
